Developer Pages

Create your own pages in a MOLGENIS database using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

Overview

The Page Editor is an EMX2 feature that allows users to create and edit EMX2 pages with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. This option may be useful if you want to go beyond the features that are offered in the Page Builder.

Get started

To create your own page, follow these steps.

  1. Sign in to your account and go to the Page Gallery
  2. Click the "Add New Page" button to view the page selection menu.
  3. Select the page you want to build, click the "ceate page" button and fill in the required information. Your page will be available in the Page Gallery
  4. Find your page in the gallery and click the edit button.
  5. Edit your page and save the changes.

Tips

There are a few options that can be used to enhance your page. These can be found in your page's settings, which can be accessed in the Developer pages table.

  • You can hook into our tailwind theme: To make it easier to build custom pages, you can piggyback off our theme. This makes styling pages and creating layouts a bit easier, and also allows you to create pages that look and feel like a MOLGENIS page. If you want use your own theme, go to the page's settings and change "enable base styles" to "false".
  • Style buttons like a MOLGENIS button: If your page uses buttons, you may also want to use our button styling. If you add the attribute type="submit" to your button, our styles will be automatically applied. You can also disable this feature, by changing the "enable button styles" setting to "false".
  • Allow pages to fill the page: By default, custom pages are have a fixed width. To allow a page to fill the entire width of a screen, change the setting "enable full screen" to "false".
